answer: The button maker's lathe turns all day, and the bone discs pile up in a wooden bowl beside his elbow. Proof of button maker mould via bone disc count is the turning: a button the maker turns only after 40 discs are cut, each disc drilled by the maker himself. The shale is the first disc, cut when the bone was boiled; the delta is the fortieth, cut when the bowl was full. A cheat must cut 31 false discs and drill 31 false buttons, and the voyage still fastens no coat.
